images.filename: Aerial view of the Union Iron Works, San Francisco, California (USA), circa in 1918 (NH 42535).jpg
images.caption:
Aerial view of the Union Iron Works, San Francisco, California (USA), photographed during World War I, with four-piper destroyers under construction at the Risdon Iron Works in the lower right. Four submarines and one destroyer hull in dry-dock are at the piers in the center, along with some large merchant ships. Risdon, part of Union, is to the lower right of the ink line.
